Browser-only unavailable surface (contract rule 7): the web BrowserPushChannelCard depends on the Notification API, PushManager, and service workers (web push), none of which exist in React Native. It is reproduced locally as an explicit 'Unavailable' card (testID nc-browser-push-card) that still renders the webpush.title/webpush.subtitle and a warning Badge (webpush.status.unsupported='Unavailable') plus a native-specific notice (webpush.unsupported.native) explaining the device receives alerts via its configured channels + OS-level push — preserving visual placement while honestly signalling the unavailable capability.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components are imported — only React (useMemo/useState), react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator/Alert/Modal/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View + StyleProp/TextStyle/ViewStyle types), the existing native AppText/GlassPanel, theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography), the native notification hooks, and the native API types. All Tailwind/CSS-var utilities are reproduced with StyleSheet + tokens (neon-cyan/green/red highlights → accent/success/danger tokens, var(--text-*) → textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted, capitalize/uppercase via textTransform).

Behavior verified by __tests__/NotificationChannelsView.test.tsx (12 tests, mocking the six notification hooks): renders root+add-button+browser-push unavailable card; renders stat skeletons while loading; renders the four metric cards (incl. '2/3' active) when stats present; renders a card per channel with secrets masked + no empty state; renders the empty state with no channels; renders skeletons while channels load; opens the add form modal with the channel type grid; blocks submit + shows 'Name is required' on a blank name; toggles a channel via toggleMut(id); deletes a channel via deleteMut(id); opens the edit form prefilled (Test Connection shown, no type grid); getChannelMeta resolves discord/pushover + falls back to webhook for unknown kinds. Gates: `npm run typecheck` PASS, `npm run lint -- --quiet` PASS, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` PASS. Source line range L1-L541 fully covered.
